glosses: to formalize (to give characteristics accepted in certain circumstances)
to formalize (to give something a definite form; to shape)
to formalize (to gain characteristics accepted in certain circumstances)
to formalize (to gain a definite form; to shape)
To give something a definite form; to shape.
To develop into a definite form.

examples.text: We have more fun and exciting fundraisers planned, and we're trying to carefully budget them so they don't cut into your life savings. As they formalize, we'll widely publicize these events.

glosses: To give something a formal or official standing.
To rigorously prove a mathematical result.
Dar la última forma a una cosa.
Cumplir con las exigencias de forma de algo, sean sociales o legales.
Otorgar un carácter oficial o definitivo, o dar autoridad legal a algo que antes era informal o no tenía ese tipo de validez.

examples.text: Japón y México oficializaron a mediados de septiembre un acuerdo de libre comercio entre los dos países que había sido firmado en marzo pero mantenía pendientes algunas negociaciones en el sector agrícola
